notes.title: Rich Uncle: A Gay Adventure released now!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Rich Uncle: A Gay Adventure has been released! 
Leo is a young gay man growing up in a remote village in Finland. A bizarre challenge takes him on a journey across Europe. Will he manage to come out on top? Will he make new friends? Will he explore his sexuality? The choices are many and they are all in your hands.

Please stay tuned for more news by following our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2278910]Steam page[/url].
